reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "With the default enablement of KVStoreMesh, if you use external workloads, ensure that your cluster has a Cluster name and ID specified before upgrading", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Before upgrading, clusters using external workloads must have a cluster name and ID specified, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh, because KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default.
consequence.remediation: Specify the cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly disable KVStoreMesh.

proposed.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default; clusters using external workloads must set a cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh.
